sourceText: Implement the product-capability-release-playbook-lineage execution plan (revision 2, audited). Operator confirmed V1 scope on 2026-07-05 after a comprehensive adversarial audit: M0-M5 + M6/M7 assert-invariant + a hermetic B-785e backfill proof; the standalone capability_release_backfill CLI and M6/M7 exposure/promotion surfaces are deferred to a follow-up story.
normalizedOutcome: A first-class, non-runtime, non-authoritative product capability release ledger is recorded at DONE and bound to playbook candidate lineage, visible via read-only capability_release_list/status, with candidates staying inert.
acceptanceClaim: DONE records a merge-stable capability release; a DONE candidate carries lineage.capabilityReleaseId; the reader fails closed on authority/gateEvidence violations; candidates never enter active surfacing and DONE success never counts as helped — all proven by hermetic smokes and lattice validate.
